answer: The wander I would price into every new account is Signed baggage handler record with airline attestation: a record the airline kept across years of turnarounds, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that a record the airline kept across years of turnarounds cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the anchor of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the orchard for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
